free_tier_limits.correction: $15 free credits per month (approximately 2,000 Ubuntu x64 2-vCPU minutes); 20 concurrent jobs by default; free artifact allowance of 20 GB/month egress and 100 GB/month storage; 9.6 GB cache storage per project.

notes: The API is organization-scoped, not hosted at api.semaphoreci.com. The submitted documentation URL still resolves to Semaphore's current API reference, whose canonical URL is docs.semaphore.io/reference/api. Official documentation does not publish API request-rate or CORS details.
